Install... (EUR).message: Be sure to enable game patching in Luma3DS (hold SELECT while booting your console, then enable "Enable Game Patching").
You will need Pretendo Network installed and enabled to use this (via Nimbus).
You will need a copy of YouTube v2080 installed.
Videos play smoothly on New 3DS consoles only. Do you wish to proceed?
The service is in public beta, it may not work as expected.
